tools.name: neetocal_list_scheduling_links
tools.description: List the workspace's scheduling links (meeting types with their booking pages): name, type, host and status. Start here to find a meeting_sid. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings.

tools.name: neetocal_get_scheduling_link
tools.description: Get one scheduling link by meeting_sid: its settings, hosts, booking rules and status. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}.

tools.name: neetocal_list_meeting_durations
tools.description: List the duration options of a scheduling link. Use a duration value when you ask for slots. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}/durations.

tools.name: neetocal_list_available_slots
tools.description: List the open booking slots of a scheduling link for one month, in the given time zone. Pass day to narrow to one date. NeetoCal API: GET /meetings/{meeting_sid}/slots.

tools.name: neetocal_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings in the workspace. Filter by client email, host email, booking type or parent booking. Results are paged. NeetoCal API: GET /bookings.

tools.name: neetocal_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking by booking_sid: client, host, slot time, status, payment and meeting outcome. NeetoCal API: GET /bookings/{booking_sid}.

tools.name: neetocal_list_payments
tools.description: List payments for bookings and package purchases, newest first, optionally in a time range. Use it for payment reports. NeetoCal API: GET /payments.

tools.name: neetocal_list_team_members
tools.description: List the team members (hosts) of the workspace. Filter by email. NeetoCal API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: neetocal_list_availabilities
tools.description: List the weekly availabilities and date overrides of one or more team members, by email. NeetoCal API: GET /availabilities.

tools.name: neetocal_list_holidays
tools.description: List the workspace holidays. On a holiday no host can be booked for the whole day, unless the availability has a date override. NeetoCal API: GET /holidays.

tools.name: neetocal_update_booking
tools.description: Change one booking by booking_sid. Set status to cancelled, approved or rejected; or reschedule it with slot_date and slot_start_time. Cancelling or rejecting changes what the client sees. NeetoCal API: PATCH /bookings/{booking_sid}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neetocal_list_bookings, neetocal_list_team_members, neetocal_list_availabilities · Public sink: neetocal_list_bookings, neetocal_list_team_members, neetocal_list_availabilities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neetocal_list_bookings, neetocal_list_team_members, neetocal_list_availabilities · Public sink: neetocal_list_bookings, neetocal_list_team_members, neetocal_list_availabilities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
